item.text: Mình đang xác minh đúng phần `splitBookIdRef` mới được thêm vào để chắc là mọi đường thoát khỏi modal đều cleanup stub như mô tả. Nếu khớp, mình sẽ chốt APPROVE.

### VERDICT
- Status: APPROVE
- Reason: Re-review of the round-2 fixes looks good. The remaining orphan-stub leak is now covered by `splitBookIdRef` cleanup on close, click-outside, mode switch, cancel, and unmount, and committed books are protected by clearing the ref on confirm success. I did not find any new blocking issues in the updated flow.
